messages:
Maya (Support): quick tweak request from support — when embedding creation fails users get a generic 'Something went wrong' banner. customers are confused and opening tickets without the request id. can we make the copy more actionable?
Priya R.: totally. don't call out raw error codes in the main line. proposed primary: 'We couldn't create your embedding.' follow with: 'Try again — if it keeps happening, contact support.' then a collapsed 'Details' with the error code and request id and a copy button.
Alex D.: +1. add a reassurance line under details: 'No data was ingested.' Also make primary CTA 'Try again' and secondary link 'Contact support' for quick next steps.
Jordan (A11y): accessibility needs: put banner in an assertive aria-live region and move focus to it on failure. 'Details' must be keyboard expandable and the copy-to-clipboard should announce success. buttons need explicit aria-labels like 'Try again (retry embedding)'.
Sam L.: implementation notes — we'll not show stack traces. if we detect rate-limit we can show 'Try again in a minute' or use Retry-After header. I'll add a small tooltip on the support link that says 'Include request id when you contact support' but keep the id in the details panel, not the tooltip.
Maya (Support): copy-to-clipboard and clear request id in details will save us lots of time. also please include request id in the support form auto-fill when the user clicks Contact support.
Priya R.: final microcopy suggestion: banner heading: 'We couldn't create your embedding.' helper copy: 'Try again — if the problem continues, contact support.' primary CTA: 'Try again' secondary: 'Contact support' details toggle label: 'Details' details content: 'Error code: E1007', 'Request id: abc-123' + 'Copy'. small reassurance text: 'No data was ingested.'
Alex D.: love it. @Sam L. can you add this copy and the a11y behaviors to the PR? we'll review in design sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
console-bot: design ticket created: 'Embedding error banner copy + a11y' and assigned to @Sam L.
